description: This file defines various classes related to audio buffer provisioning, including buffer providers for passthrough, downmixing, remixing, reformatting, clamping, timestretching, channel adjustment, and tee buffering, used within the Android media framework.

classes.name: PassthruBufferProvider
classes.description: Provides a passthrough buffer interface for audio data, allowing reset and buffer setting.

classes.name: CopyBufferProvider
classes.description: Base class for buffer providers that handle format or channel mask conversions, with a pure virtual copyFrames method.

classes.name: DownmixerBufferProvider
classes.description: Performs position-dependent downmixing using an audio effect.

classes.name: ChannelMixBufferProvider
classes.description: Performs channel mixing to support different channel masks.

classes.name: RemixBufferProvider
classes.description: Performs upmix or downmix to adjust channel count and mask.

classes.name: ReformatBufferProvider
classes.description: Converts input data to an acceptable mixer input format.

classes.name: ClampFloatBufferProvider
classes.description: Clamps float audio data within -3dB range.

classes.name: TimestretchBufferProvider
classes.description: Performs time stretching on audio data.

classes.name: AdjustChannelsBufferProvider
classes.description: Adjusts sample data for channel expansion or contraction, supporting haptic playback adjustments.

classes.name: TeeBufferProvider
classes.description: Duplicates audio data to a tee buffer for monitoring or processing.

methods.name: copyFrames
methods.description: Copies a number of frames from source to destination, implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: getNextBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the next buffer of audio data.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for timestretching.

methods.name: processFrames
methods.description: Processes and transforms audio frames during timestretching.

methods.name: clearContractedFrames
methods.description: Clears the count of contracted frames in channel adjustment.

methods.name: copyFrames
methods.description: Copies frames with specific format or channel adjustments.

methods.name: clearFramesCopied
methods.description: Resets the count of frames copied in TeeBufferProvider.
